_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro: {num_players}-Onye na-egwu egwu gburugburu na {width}x{height} grid. Ị bụ onye ọkpụkpọ {player_id}. Mgbanwe ndị dị irè: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' ma ọ bụ w / s / a / d. Ihe mgbaru ọsọ: dị ndụ karịa onye ọ bụla ọzọ. Ụzọ ndị dị egwu; mgbidi na-egbu egbu; ihu ihu na-egbu ma.

board.after_moves:
Oche mgbe ịme njem n'otu oge:
{board}

game_action.invalid_death: Onye na-egwu egwu {player_id} nwụrụ n'ihi na ọ bụ ihe na-abaghị uru.

outcome.survived_win: Onye na-egwu egwu {player_id} lanarịrị; ndị ọzọ niile dara.
outcome.all_crashed: Ndị egwuregwu nile dara n'otu oge.
outcome.outlived: Onye na-egwu egwu dị ndụ karịa ndị ọzọ niile.
outcome.turn_limit: E ruola oke ntụgharị - onye ka dị ndụ ruo ogologo oge na-emeri.
